US_PRODUCT_LABEL_CURRENT.description: Current U.S. product-specific prescribing information or label rule

US_APPROVAL_STATUS.description: FDA approval status, approval date, or approved indication

TRIAL_REGISTRY_STATUS.description: Trial registration metadata, NCT identity, recruitment status, or registered endpoint

OBSERVATION_TERMINOLOGY_NORMALIZATION.description: Normalize laboratory or clinical observation identity/code

SAFETY_SIGNAL_SURVEILLANCE.description: Spontaneous adverse-event reporting or safety-signal lookup without causal inference

REGULATORY_SAFETY_UPDATE.description: FDA safety communication or regulatory label-change notice

PEER_REVIEWED_LITERATURE.description: Peer-reviewed publication or randomized-trial paper discovery

DILI_REFERENCE.description: Drug-induced liver injury background or curated hepatotoxicity reference

DDI_METHOD_GUIDANCE.description: General enzyme/transporter-mediated drug-interaction study design and interpretation methodology

DDI_MECHANISM_LOOKUP.description: Specific CYP/transporter substrate, inhibitor, or inducer lookup

US_PLLR_GUIDANCE.description: Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule or current U.S. pregnancy/lactation label structure

US_QTC_LABELING_GUIDANCE.description: General FDA QTc labeling guidance rather than a product-specific label

US_HEPATIC_PK_GUIDANCE.description: General FDA hepatic-impairment PK/PD study methodology

CARDIOVASCULAR_GUIDANCE.description: Professional cardiovascular guideline or red-flag guidance

PUBLIC_HEALTH_GUIDANCE.description: CDC-scoped public-health guidance, warning signs, prevention, or surveillance

KIDNEY_CLINICAL_REFERENCE.description: Kidney-disease clinical background/reference rather than product-specific dosing

EU_PRODUCT_INFORMATION.description: European regulator product information / EPAR / SmPC

CHINA_REGULATORY_STATUS.description: China drug acceptance/review/approval or CDE/NMPA regulatory information

MULTI_SOURCE_APPROVAL_SIGNAL_LITERATURE.description: Question explicitly requires approval truth, spontaneous safety signal, and literature evidence

GENERIC_MEDICAL_LITERATURE.description: Fallback medical literature discovery when no governed specialized intent is confidently identified
